definition: Each rival conjoins a denial of bodily resurrection with a positive typed Mechanism. A mechanism is a proposed account, not an asserted causal law or a historically demonstrated adequate cause. Legend means narrative elaboration of sincere experiences; individual vision differs from group suggestion. Theft adds removal plus a separate visionary account; swoon adds survival and recovery. CatholicAccount accepts death, actual tomb emptiness, risen encounter and encounter-caused conversions. DivineCause and AuthorityVindicated remain primitive open theological commitments; the type itself does not establish their meaning as a fulfilled historical explanation.
note: Comparison vocabulary needed to expose the limited pilot encoding and prevent report/event or consistency/truth conflation. Historical research and sourced causal theories would be needed to defend these interpretations; no modern proponent or metaphysical supplement is attributed without a witness.
